tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Search Nomads.com for the best cities to live and work remotely. Filters: budget, region, country, internet speed, safety, temperature. Returns at most 100 cities sorted by overall score. Each city includes costs, internet, weather, air quality, safety/cleanliness/healthcare/fun and other 0-5 scores

tools.name: list_meetups
tools.description: Upcoming Nomads.com meetups: where and when nomads meet in person, and how many people are going. Filter by city slug, country or how far ahead to look. Attendance is a count only; who attends is private.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_meetup, edit_meetup, cancel_meetup · Private data: list_meetups, get_favorites, get_trips · Public sink: search_cities · Destructive: remove_favorite, remove_trip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_meetup, edit_meetup, cancel_meetup · Private data: list_meetups, get_favorites, get_trips · Public sink: search_cities · Destructive: remove_favorite, remove_trip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
